needed.evidence: A continuous, purpose-built sidewalk is visible on the right side, separated from the road by a kerb.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk on the right side to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: A clear junction is visible where the main road meets a side street, creating a high demand for crossing, but no marked or signalised crossing is present.
needed.suggestion: Install a clearly marked zebra crossing at the junction to provide a safe and visible place for pedestrians to cross.

needed.evidence: The junction where a crossing is needed has standard, un-dropped kerbs, which would impede access for wheelchairs and prams.
needed.suggestion: Construct a raised crossing with dropped kerbs at the junction to ensure safe and accessible passage for all pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The entire visible stretch of the urban road is devoid of any street lighting poles or fixtures.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of streetlights along both sides of the road to improve visibility and safety for all users during low-light conditions.
